genre.description: Crack clues to escape locked rooms

story.title: Whispers of the Interstitial
story.setting: Perched on the precipice of the Great Bifurcation, your phytolab hangs amidst a tangled web of iridescent data-spines and living conduits, stretching into an endless, pulsating void.
story.description: As Kith, a renowned xeno-botanist, you must navigate your crumbling phytolab, using a bespoke bio-acoustic interface to translate the panicked thoughts of the exotic flora around you. These vegetal whispers reveal not just the immediate structural dangers, but also fragmented, paradoxical truths about the Interstitial, a realm that exists *between* logic, where reality can be rewoven by aligning with its non-Euclidean frequencies.
